attchmntText: Magnum Ventures Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Magnum Ventures Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a loss after tax of 21.14 lakhs for the quarter and 848.84 lakhs for the half year. Revenue from operations stood at 13,054.54 lakhs for the quarter. The board also approved the proposed upgrade of the company's hotel from Country Inn & Suites by Radisson to Radisson Blu, targeting completion during the financial year 2026-27. Additionally, the board noted initiatives to enhance paper unit production capacity from 220 MT per day to 260 MT per day and the introduction of Refuse-Derived Fuel. The auditor's report highlighted a SEBI penalty of 12,00,000 rupees against the company, which has been deposited pending the outcome of an appeal scheduled for December 1, 2026.
